_readme: US BLS macro release dates. The BLS schedule page renders its table in JavaScript, so these CANNOT be scraped - the served HTML contains no dates. Everything here was transcribed by hand from https://www.bls.gov/schedule/2026/home.htm opened in a browser. Times are 08:30 America/New_York; the app converts to UTC using the real IANA timezone so DST is handled correctly (DST ends 2026-11-01).
_dst: October is EDT (UTC-4) so 08:30 ET = 12:30 UTC = 18:00 IST. From 1 November it is EST (UTC-5) so 08:30 ET = 13:30 UTC = 19:00 IST.
